profile_text.body:
The site at counsel.com is for WealthCounsel, which describes itself as offering estate planning software for attorneys, with additional solutions for elder law, business law, trust administration, CLE, and legal marketing. Its memberships bundle document drafting tools: the Elite membership gives access to Wealth Docx Complete, Elder Docx, Business Docx, Wealth Tracx, and Gun Docx, while the Trusts & Estates Professional membership gives access to Wealth Docx Complete, Business Docx, Wealth Tracx, and Gun Docx. The company also describes continuing legal education, practice building webinars, and legal marketing resources.

The only AI product tracked for this company is SaulLM (Saul), listed under Chat & General LLMs. It is described as a French legal-domain LLM with specialized training and EU data governance. No lawsuits, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent facts are recorded for the company.
